properties.name: hibernate.cache.use_second_level_cache
properties.description: Whether to enable Hibernate's second-level cache.

properties.name: hibernate.cache.use_query_cache
properties.description: Whether to enable Hibernate's query cache.

properties.name: hibernate.generatedDomainClasses
properties.description: No longer used. Native domain binding (Hibernate's own annotation binder over classes generated from the GORM mapping) is the only binding; the classic domain binding of Grails 8 was removed. The setting is ignored with a warning at startup. See Native Domain Binding in the GORM for Hibernate 7 manual.

deprecation.reason: The classic domain binding was removed; native domain binding is the only binding.

properties.name: hibernate.grails.proxy.lazy_to_string
properties.description: Whether toString() on an uninitialized entity proxy returns entityName:id without initializing it. When false (the default, matching Grails 7 and earlier), toString() initializes the proxy and delegates to the domain class's own implementation.
